name: Bvlgari Hotel, Dubai
positioning: Italian-designed beachfront resort on Jumeira Bay Island, called Bvlgari Resort Dubai on the official site, with a marina, yacht club and beach club
best_for: Travelers who want a resort with its own marina and beach club
Food lovers drawn to Michelin-starred Italian and Japanese dining
Guests who want a private villa with its own pool

facts.text: The resort occupies a stretch of coastline on Jumeira Bay Island.
Italian studio ACPV Architects, Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, designed the interiors and exteriors.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito has held two Michelin stars from the Michelin Guide Dubai since 2022.
Hoseki is a Japanese omakase restaurant with just seventeen seats.
Details at the bottom of the Yacht Clvb pool are inspired by vintage brooches from the 1920s.
The resort has the world's first Bvlgari Marina and Yacht Clvb, overlooking a 46-boat harbour.
Serpenti Beach Clvb has cabanas, daybeds and terraces in golden-orange hues.
Every accommodation comes with its own balcony.
The Bulgari Villas sit in private gardens with sun decks and swimming pools.
The Yacht Clvb includes The Little Gems Clvb for kids.

considerations.text: The location is away from the main resort areas of the city, and Downtown Dubai is less than 15 minutes away by car.
The resort has a grown-up ambience, though children are made welcome.
WhataHotel notes the island location means transport is needed to reach mainland attractions.
